// chart.jsx — live download/upload area chart (SVG) for torrnet.
// Exports SpeedChart, Sparkline to window.
(function () {
  const { useRef } = React;

  // history: array of {d, u} in bytes/s. maxPoints kept by caller.
  function SpeedChart({ history, height = 120, accent = "#E76A2E", up = "#1f9e8f" }) {
    const pts = history.length ? history : [{ d: 0, u: 0 }];
    const w = 600; // viewBox width, scales via preserveAspectRatio
    const h = height;
    const pad = 6;
    const max = Math.max(1, ...pts.map((p) => Math.max(p.d, p.u))) * 1.2;
    const n = Math.max(pts.length, 2);
    const x = (i) => pad + (i / (n - 1)) * (w - pad * 2);
    const y = (v) => h - pad - (v / max) * (h - pad * 2);

    function area(key) {
      let d = `M ${x(0)} ${h - pad}`;
      pts.forEach((p, i) => { d += ` L ${x(i)} ${y(p[key])}`; });
      d += ` L ${x(n - 1)} ${h - pad} Z`;
      return d;
    }
    function line(key) {
      return pts.map((p, i) => `${i ? "L" : "M"} ${x(i)} ${y(p[key])}`).join(" ");
    }

    const last = pts[pts.length - 1];
    return (
      <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${w} ${h}`} preserveAspectRatio="none" style={{ width: "100%", height, display: "block" }}>
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id="gd" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0%" stopColor={accent} stopOpacity="0.28" />
            <stop offset="100%" stopColor={accent} stopOpacity="0" />
          </linearGradient>
          <linearGradient id="gu" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0%" stopColor={up} stopOpacity="0.20" />
            <stop offset="100%" stopColor={up} stopOpacity="0" />
          </linearGradient>
        </defs>
        {[0.25, 0.5, 0.75].map((g) => (
          <line key={g} x1={pad} x2={w - pad} y1={h - pad - g * (h - pad * 2)} y2={h - pad - g * (h - pad * 2)}
            stroke="var(--grid)" strokeWidth="1" strokeDasharray="2 4" />
        ))}
        <path d={area("u")} fill="url(#gu)" />
        <path d={line("u")} fill="none" stroke={up} strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinejoin="round" />
        <path d={area("d")} fill="url(#gd)" />
        <path d={line("d")} fill="none" stroke={accent} strokeWidth="2" strokeLinejoin="round" />
        <circle cx={x(n - 1)} cy={y(last.d)} r="3" fill={accent} />
      </svg>
    );
  }

  // tiny inline sparkline for table rows
  function Sparkline({ data, color = "#E76A2E", w = 72, h = 22 }) {
    const pts = data && data.length ? data : [0, 0];
    const max = Math.max(1, ...pts);
    const n = Math.max(pts.length, 2);
    const d = pts.map((v, i) => `${i ? "L" : "M"} ${(i / (n - 1)) * w} ${h - (v / max) * (h - 2) - 1}`).join(" ");
    return (
      <svg width={w} height={h} style={{ display: "block" }}>
        <path d={d} fill="none" stroke={color} strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeLinecap="round" />
      </svg>
    );
  }

  Object.assign(window, { SpeedChart, Sparkline });
})();
